name: 95330 · Lathrop, CA
findings: ZIP 95330 (Lathrop) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95330 (Lathrop) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95330 (Lathrop) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).
